name: Hand counts read the hand of the player the words name, not the open tab's
notes: Found while fixing Ensnaring Bridge (project_bess_base_pt_and_amount_in_subject_2026-10-14). _computeForEachCount read every 'cards in … hand(s)' off Battlefield.gameState, the player whose tab is open. _countCardsInHand (engine-compute.js) now reads each player's own Cards in Hand. Hands: Player 1 two, Player 2 three, Player 3 one. Maro (Player 2's, 'your hand') 3/3. Multani (all players' hands) 6/6. Enemy of Enlightenment (5/5, -1/-1 per card in your opponents' hands) 1/1. Adamaro (the opponent with the most cards in hand) 3/3. Righteous Authority (Player 1's) on Player 3's Grizzly Bears ('its controller's hand') 3/3. Nyxathid (7/7, chosen player's hand) with nobody chosen reads the first opponent, Player 2: 4/4. Memory: project_hand_count_by_player_2026-10-14.

scryfallData.name: Maro
scryfallData.oracle_text: Maro's power and toughness are each equal to the number of cards in your hand.
scryfallData.flavor_text: No two see the same Maro.

scryfallData.name: Multani, Maro-Sorcerer
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Shroud (This creature can't be the target of spells or abilities.)
Multani's power and toughness are each equal to the total number of cards in all players' hands.
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"To make peace with the forest, make peace with me."
—Multani, to Urza

scryfallData.name: Enemy of Enlightenment
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Flying
This creature gets -1/-1 for each card in your opponents' hands.
At the beginning of your upkeep, each player discards a card.
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"Evil flourishes where ignorance thrives."
—Perisophia the philosopher

scryfallData.name: Adamaro, First to Desire
scryfallData.oracle_text: Adamaro's power and toughness are each equal to the number of cards in the hand of the opponent with the most cards in hand.
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"Beware Adamaro! In him all pain and anger is perfected."
—Isao, Enlightened Bushi

scryfallData.name: Nyxathid
scryfallData.oracle_text:
As this creature enters, choose an opponent.
This creature gets -1/-1 for each card in the chosen player's hand.
scryfallData.flavor_text: Born of volcanic forces, it thrives on the absolute panic it inspires.

scryfallData.name: Grizzly Bears
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"We cannot forget that among all of Dominaria's wonders, a system of life exists, with prey and predators that will never fight wars nor vie for ancient power."
—Jolrael, empress of beasts

scryfallData.name: Righteous Authority
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 for each card in its controller's hand.
At the beginning of the draw step of enchanted creature's controller, that player draws an additional card.
